# Published test vectors for linkup/noise.cpp, for noise-test.cpp. Copied, not made here:
#
#   The first blocks are from github.com/flynn/noise, vectors.txt (BSD 3-Clause): every block of
#   the four patterns LinkUp's code can run, on X25519, ChaCha20-Poly1305 and SHA-256.
#   The rest are from cacophony (public domain), as github.com/mcginty/snow keeps them in
#   tests/vectors/cacophony.txt, rewritten into the same lines.
#
# Keys are hex. Each block runs from a `handshake=` line to a blank line. After the handshake
# the two sources order their messages differently: flynn's take the first key from Split, then
# the second, whatever the pattern; cacophony's go on taking turns, and a one-way pattern's are all
# the initiator's. `source=cacophony` says which.
